item.summary: perf(plugins): reuse one plugin metadata snapshot per CLI process (#129181) * perf(plugins): reuse one plugin metadata snapshot per CLI process Built CLI measurements with the same fs shim and isolated state copy:\n- status --json: 174.3k -> 52.8k fs calls; 4.33-4.41s -> 2.63-3.94s\n- agents list --json: 50.7k -> 38.3k fs calls; 2.32-2.93s -> 2.20-2.28s * style(config): use type-only snapshot imports * fix(cli): scope plugin snapshot adoption to inventory reads * test(cli): align snapshot harnesses with adoption
